reviews.title: Trash app for Apple products
reviews.text: Horrible! 2 of us have been trying to sync this s3 frontier watch to my 15 pro max for 2 hours, finally reaching out to Google and ChatGPT for advice and found them saying Samsung doesn’t want to work with Apple and therefore not fixing their app to be compatible with Apple Products. Why even have the app available on Apple then?? I’ve reset the watch numerous times, followed every direction and I might get lucky enough that it will try to finally pair only to be unsuccessful and loop us through the whole setup again and again. This app feels like it came from Temu and not a quality product you’d expect from Samsung. What a shame! Guess I’ll just have to return this watch to Amazon and get an Apple Watch. If this Samsungs way of trying to convert Apple users to Samsung, what a disgrace

reviews.title: Why is it only watches
reviews.text:
I was gifted some used Samsung ear buds. I see that to factory reset them I need the “wearables” app. I look for it, can’t find it. I go to their website, and it has links for whatever device you’re using. I click on the Apple one, and it brought me here. I installed it assuming that since the site says it’s for all their connected devices, they must’ve just named it something dumb. But no, it’s just for their watches. The other links take you to the actual wearables app, but they don’t have one for Apple apparently, meaning they don’t make their BT earbuds at least to be compatible with Apple devices.

Please at least update your site to specify.
